name: heldout-room1-v2-procedure
status: Procedure only; nothing generated. Reviewed by the orchestrator 2026-09-26 (sound, with the edits applied here). Generation needs the owner's approval.
why: The Room 1 held-out set (config/heldout_starts.json, sha256 54d62e86...) carries the published Phase 3B result and has now been used for two descriptive retention pilots (aggregates only). The orchestrator asked for a fresh Room 1 set before any confirmatory retention experiment, so nothing the pilots saw can shape the confirmatory measure. The procedure is fixed before any such experiment is designed.

original_set_as_found.output: config/heldout_starts.json, generated 2026-09-20T00:32:09 at 235df9b, 200 states, 11 routes (runs/heldout-routes/20260920-001246 to -002044), task frames 20 to 404
original_set_as_found.seeds: route.json seeds 100 to 110 in runs/heldout-routes; the folder runs/heldout-routes/20260920-002108 holds only episode.tas (a search that started and left no route, probably seed 111), so 111 counts as tried
original_set_as_found.other_room1_namespaces: runs/routes holds the 7 demonstration routes (seeds 0 to 6) and seeds 100 to 104 from 2026-09-19 01:25 to 01:31: the routes of the retired first held-out set, which its generator wrote into the demonstration folder (caught before any training used them; the set was replaced on 2026-09-20). Checked 2026-09-26: each is action-for-action identical to the same seed's route in runs/heldout-routes, so --exclude-heldout config/heldout_starts.json already excludes them.

procedure.route_namespace: runs/heldout-routes-v2 (new, empty; never runs/heldout-routes or runs/routes; the name contains 'heldout', so evaluate_checkpoint.py's input guard refuses it)
procedure.seed_rule: --first-seed 128, above every seed used in any namespace of either room (Room 1: 0 to 6, 100 to 111; Room 2: up to 127), so no seed can be ambiguous; a seed counts as tried once its search process starts (the attempt records under runs/heldout-routes-v2/_attempts make this automatic), and a tried seed is never retried
procedure.stuck_route_rule: as in the Room 2 v2 procedure: if a guard rejects a route, search the missing routes with new seeds, then build with --routes <accepted directories> --searches 0, and record the excluded route and the reason; never delete a route folder

validation: zero overlap with the 7 Room 1 demonstration routes (existing guard)
zero overlap with the 11 routes of config/heldout_starts.json (--exclude-heldout, G1)
the manifest validates with celeste_rl.heldout.validate_manifest and carries the Room 1 task identity
descriptive_after_generation: Optional, descriptive only, never a refusal: one aggregate count of new states that share (task frame, position, dashes) with any state of config/heldout_starts.json or any demonstration state. Early states near the room entrance are expected to coincide. Also, descriptively, that no new route's action trace matches any route.json in runs/routes or runs/heldout-routes (expected by construction: the demonstration guard, --exclude-heldout and fresh seeds).
protections: No policy is evaluated on the new set until a new experiment's plan pins its path and sha256.
The new file is committed on its own immediately after generation, with every seed tried and its outcome in the commit message.
A launch-only readiness check (Steam fully started) runs before generation, as after the Room 2 v2 attempt 1.
estimated_run_time: About 20 to 40 minutes if every seed finds a route quickly (the original: 11 routes in about 20 minutes); up to about 2 hours if searches run their full 10-minute budget.
remeasure_rule: Every value a later experiment compares against (donor 'before' values, the floor, the imitation-only reference) must be re-measured on the new set before a confirmatory experiment; the pilot numbers measured on config/heldout_starts.json cannot be carried over.
route_count_decision: 11 routes and 200 states, matching the original set (orchestrator review 2026-09-26).
room2_routes: Not excluded: a different task identity, so no Room 2 route can repeat a Room 1 route.
